notes: Jira was read on atlassian.com/software/jira pages (product family). The pricing page answered HTTP 200 but its fetched snapshot is thin (717 characters: the plan table renders client side). Pass 2 (8 Oct): the pricing page was read once in a real browser (manifest method browser, 7,806 characters) and is no longer needed; it confirms C02 and C04 but does not settle C03 (it shows 'Capacity management' as a comparison row with no per-plan text and says nothing of individual allocations or percentages), so C03 stays unverifiable. Pass 2 completeness: the two gap lines (DevOps toolchain integration with no named product; evaluation advice citing atlassian.com) are out of scope, and the comparison tables and Jira sub-headings in the full answers carry no in-scope statement beyond the existing claims (feature checkmarks, star ratings and capability lines are out of scope). No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing and no cited page was read for causes. Every other claim is settled by the cited plans guide, the Plans guide, the product page or the integrations page (the integrations URL redirected to /software/jira/features/integrations). Not coded: the module name Plans or Advanced Plans (a feature name like Portfolios elsewhere; no answer states the rename from Advanced Roadmaps), market share and adoption lines (out of scope), generic connection lines with no named product ('development-tool connections', 'integration with DevOps toolchains'), and the 40-hour-week capacity limitation in q7 ChatGPT run 3 (a capability description). C05 treats 'Atlassian Jira' as an X-by-Y naming fact, as the Fieldwire example did with 'Fieldwire by Hilti'; the page shows the Jira name under the Atlassian brand rather than the literal string 'Atlassian Jira'.
